Not a clear match; omitted.

Decrease in cell proliferation is the same endpoint as the cell proliferation events in this group, but in the opposite direction, so it is flagged for curator review as a context/direction variant.
Decline in population trajectory is the same decreased population-level outcome as 'Decreased, Population trajectory'.
Decreased intratesticular testosterone is the same decreased testosterone endpoint in a specific compartment (testis).

new_groups.rationale: These all share decreased testosterone by fetal Leydig cells as the downstream event, but are paired with different upstream events, so they are flagged for curator review.
These are relationship-style events in adult Leydig cell steroidogenesis and testosterone production, with different upstream mechanisms.
These all involve decreased cholesterol with different upstream processes (synthesis, uptake, transport).
Both describe reduced expression of steroidogenic enzymes/proteins with differing specificity.
Both are decreased promoter or gene methylation in dopamine-related genes.
Serotonin transporter inhibition and increased serotonin are related, but the transporter and its substrate are different objects, so this is a questionable pair; excluded.
Decreased fertility and decreased population relate to reproductive/population-level outcomes at different scales.
Placeholder grouping rejected.
Both are decreases in eNOS-pathway activity, but they address different objects; this is a weak grouping and is omitted from consideration.
Inhibition of different deiodinase isoforms (DIO2 vs DIO1) is the same process on different enzymes.
Reduced swim bladder inflation, posterior versus anterior chamber.
Induction of paralysis in somatic muscle versus pharyngeal muscle.
Both describe decreased GnRH release, with different specifics (kisspeptin stimulation vs pulsatility in the hypothalamus).
Increased thyroid hormone (T3 in tissues vs T4 in serum) in different compartments.
Increased prolactin exposure vs increased prolactin secretion, related prolactin increase events with different specifics.
Reduced progesterone synthesis vs decreased progesterone levels are the same reduced hormone endpoint at different process/compartment levels.
Both concern the GnRH receptor gene; promoter hypermethylation and decreased expression are distinct processes.
Both concern retinoic acid signaling; decreased atRA concentration and decreased RAR activation are distinct processes.
Chitin synthase inhibition and decreased cuticular chitin content both concern chitin synthesis but are distinct events, enzyme versus product.
Hyperinflammation and systemic inflammatory response syndrome are the same inflammatory process at different scope.
Both concern retinoic acid signaling, but increased all-trans retinoic acid concentration (the ligand) and increased RAR activation (the receptor) are distinct events.
Defects in tanning of new cuticle and impaired cuticle sclerotization both describe increased defects in cuticle hardening and tanning.
Both describe decreased myelin basic protein expression, one general and the other specific to oligodendrocytes.
Increased or abnormal remodeling in different tissues (cardiac, vascular, neural).
Both describe decreased sodium, one as uptake in gills and the other as plasma concentration, which are different compartments.
Activation of the oxidative stress pathway and elevated mitochondrial ROS describe oxidative stress at different levels of specificity and compartment.
General disrupted energy metabolism and specific glycolysis or OXPHOS changes.
